column1: # The blocker ranking: constructs nothing in this engine answers, ranked by
# the documents they hold back. A report, never a gate. sole: documents this
# construct alone blocks. share: thousandths of a document summed over the
# documents it blocks, splitting each document between its blockers. docs:
# documents it appears in (an aggregate row sums its constructs'). kind: the
# subject namespace (ctrl | env | aggregate). owner: what defines it

# (primitive | kernel | class: | pkg:

, a file inside the TeX
# distribution named by its own stem; or document | nonpublic | unattributed,
# each folded into one aggregate row carrying counts and no name).
# "Blocked" means "has at least one unknown construct", which is narrower
# than the parity ladder's P0: a document that elaborates with errors and no
# unknown name is unblocked here and still fails P0.
